notes.title: Robots at Midnight Community Contest Winners Announced!
notes.content:
[h2][b]⚙️ Rise of the Machines ⚙️[/b] 
Robots at Midnight Fan Art Showdown Contest Winners Announced!

Thank you to everyone who submitted their incredible art! After careful review, we’re thrilled to announce the winners:

[b]🥇 1st Place: Captain Ferron by Jahol[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743987/605a02247aa0c12a72e8f06888129980a1d0547c.jpg"][/img][/h2][h2]
[b]🥈 2nd Place: Confrontation by Lionpride[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743987/46362fa3693197d2f35171dc56caa5dfa92cdb90.jpg"][/img][/h2][p][/p][h2]
[b]⭐ Fan Favorite: Catch and Pass by Jenz[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743987/05fa78f36b9fbd6251027e5edf38904d407842e9.jpg"][/img]Congratulations to all of the winners, [url="https://discord.gg/smGVU9SQg2"]please join our Discord[/url] and ping an admin or developer to claim your prize! Please claim your prize by September 23, 2025! 

We’re truly humbled by the creativity, passion, and time you poured into this contest. Robots at Midnight wouldn’t be what it is without fans like you. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts to everyone who submitted.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743987/f3404c00d1c29bba26f66d59c66052aebbb0b899.gif"][/img][/h2]

notes.title: Robots at Midnight Community Contest – Extended!
notes.content: [h2][b]⚙️ [/b]Rise of the Machines [b]⚙️ [/b][/h2][h2][b]Fan Art Showdown - EXTENDED![/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][u][b]New Deadline: August 20, 2025[/b][/u][/h3][p][/p][p]Big thanks to everyone who’s already submitted to the [i]Rise of the Machines[/i] Fan Art Showdown, your entries have blown us away and brought the world of Yob to life in incredible ways.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve received lots of amazing submissions, but also heard from many of you who wanted just a little more time, so we’re officially extending the contest by one month![/p][p] [/p][h3] [b]New Timeline:[/b][/h3][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Phase[/p][/th][th][p]Date[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Submission Deadline:[/b][/p][/td][td][p]August 20, 2025[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Community Voting:[/b][/p][/td][td][p]August 20–27[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Winners Announced:[/b][/p][/td][td][p]August 30, 2025[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]Whether you’re still putting the finishing touches on your art or just hearing about the event for the first time, this is your chance to join the uprising. Design a robot, survivor, or original character that fits into the retro-futuristic world of Yob, and upload it via the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/edititem/2623040/3/?snr=1_5_9_"]Steam Community Artwork tab[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Click here to find submission rules and full contest details:[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2623040/view/497198852915331140?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you haven't already, please join us on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FsmGVU9SQg2"]discord[/url] to find out more![/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.1 for Robots at Midnight is officially live!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Patch 1.1 is Live! New Settings, Fixes, Languages & More [/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]This update brings a wave of community-requested improvements, new features, and expanded language support to make your journey through Yob even smoother and more immersive. Whether you’re here for the story or the challenge, there’s something new for everyone.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Game Modes: Play Your Way[/b][/h3][p]Patch 1.1 introduces the ability to switch between difficulty settings mid-game without losing your progress. You can now swap freely between:[/p][list][*][p][b]Hero Mode[/b]: Experience the action and story at an approachable pace[/p][/*][*][p][b]Master Mode[/b]: For players prepared to face a challenge [/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you’re finding things too easy or hitting a difficulty spike, this change lets you adjust on the fly without starting over. Just head to the Options Menu at any time to choose your preferred challenge level.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743987/b2aa448013c17b269f889a2581e312e0c34aaebc.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]New Language Support[/b][/h3][p]We’re excited to welcome even more players into [i]Robots at Midnight[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Russian, Turkish, and Ukrainian are now fully supported![/p][/*][*][p]Translation polish and typo fixes across all supported languages[/p][/*][*][p]Updated achievement translations for clarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Visual Settings & Brightness Tuning[/b][/h3][p]We’ve added more options to help you customize your visual experience:[/p][list][*][p]Toggle Volumetric Fog[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust Bloom and Ambient Occlusion[/p][/*][*][p]Updated lookup tables for improved tone and color balance[/p][/*][*][p]Brightness tweaks in early-game areas to enhance visibility[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeumxO5-bbkqVJoXDxCEVzbGPY8uTkn6mFLkPPYRbpawR7SJQqMJg7HWm6UrdKVMJ0oDm_e2hdpyKssCK0SnTDMW4z4fFQwsOCPdDVAms9BXH_zJBj8LqMsUZ9nxjY6FH1U2hg?key=lxllMb9Z8FuDyB9U3UmF3A"][/img][/p][h3][b]Quest Fixes & Inventory Glitches[/b][/h3][p]Fixes include:[/p][list][*][p]Quest items are now visible from greater distances[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Additional Quality of Life Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Game Mode selection UI updated for clarity[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdTlxC7dX4goMyEJb9gESHrTtp7q0-U2uLiv_CUA_Y0jQCmGU2JDuf4U3ovT941OMRzSj1fly6-3aDYYAT4jv7uq87c6pWrbESNEFEEw_SNdvfAiCyf8pFX1CcmIyq0cmDXHYh3?key=lxllMb9Z8FuDyB9U3UmF3A"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Unlock icon now appears on the main menu after completing the game[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743987/b280a1516bc90162fec1e6814b70ce2ccf0ff55c.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Various under-the-hood stability and performance improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Thank You[/b][/h2][h3]To everyone who’s joined us since launch: thank you for playing, sharing, and supporting [i]Robots at Midnight[/i]. Your feedback is helping us build a better game with every patch! Stay tuned for future updates! [/h3][p][/p][h1]Don't forget to [url="https://discord.gg/smGVU9SQg2"]join us on Discord![/url][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743987/f3404c00d1c29bba26f66d59c66052aebbb0b899.gif"][/img][/p][h3]
[/h3]

notes.title: Robots at Midnight Fan Art Showdown Community Contest
notes.content:
[h2][b]⚙️ Rise of the Machines ⚙️ 
[/b]Robots at Midnight Fan Art Showdown[/h2][h3][/h3][h3][i]A fan art contest set on the planet Yob, home of Robots at Midnight[/i][/h3][p][/p][p]The machine uprising has begun on Yob — a brutal, post-collapse planet where humanity’s last survivors fight for control against rogue AI and cybernetic war machines.[/p][p][/p][p]Your mission: Create fan art that brings the world of [i]Robots at Midnight[/i] to life. You can draw one of the characters from the game or design your own robot, scavenger, or survivor that feels like it belongs on the planet Yob.[/p][p][/p][p]Your art can be [b]hand-drawn, digital, or animated (gif)[/b] — whatever style you choose, make it look like it fits in the retro-futuristic world of [i]Robots at Midnight[/i].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Timeline:[/b][/h3][table equalcells="1" colwidth="187,"][tr][td colwidth="187"][p][b]Phase[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Date [/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="187"][p]Submissions Open[/p][/td][td][p]June 20, 2025[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="187"][p]Deadline[/p][/td][td][p]July 20, 2025[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="187"][p]Community Voting[/p][/td][td][p]July 20 - 27[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="187"][p]Winners Announced[/p][/td][td][p]July 30, 2025[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3][b]Submission Details:[/b][/h3][p]All entries must be submitted via the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/edititem/2623040/3/"]Steam Community Artwork[/url] tab for [i]Robots at Midnight[/i]. Here’s how to enter:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Create your art[/b] – Submit [b]fan art of a character from Robots at Midnight[/b] [i]or[/i] design your own original robot, scavenger, or tech-infused survivor that fits within the retro-futuristic world of Yob. All visual formats are welcome:[/p][list][*][p]Hand-drawn[/p][/*][*][p]Digital illustration[/p][/*][*][p]Animation (gif)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Upload your piece to Steam by July 20, 2025:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Visit the [i]Robots at Midnight[/i] [b]Steam page[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Go to the [b]Community Hub[/b] > [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2623040/images/"]Artwork[/url] tab[/p][/*][*][p]Click [url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/edititem/2623040/3/"]Upload Artwork[/url][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Title your post: [/b]Rise of the Machines - {Your Character’s Name}[/p][/*][*][p][b]Make sure your artwork is set to public[/b] so the community and dev team can view and vote![/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3][b]Prizes[/b][/h3][table equalcells="1" colwidth="196,"][tr][td colwidth="196"][p][b]Placement[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Reward[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="196"][p]🥇 1st Place[/p][/td][td][p]$100 Steam Gift Card + Merch Pack + Social Feature + Arduino Engineering Kit [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="196"][p]🥈 2nd Place[/p][/td][td][p]$50 Steam Gift Card + Merch Pack + Social Feature + Mini Synthesizer [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="196"][p]⭐ Fan Favorite[/p][/td][td][p]Merch Pack + Social Spotlight + Makey Makey Classic[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3][b]Submission Rules[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Stick to the Theme[/b] – Your art must be inspired by [i]Robots at Midnight[/i]. You can draw a game character or create your own robot, scavenger, or survivor that fits the world of Yob.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Keep it in Style[/b] – Your art should look like it belongs in the [i]Robots at Midnight[/i] universe (retro-futuristic, gritty, and sci-fi). [/p][/*][*][p][b]Original Art Only[/b] – All artwork must be created by [b]you[/b]. No tracing, copying, or using AI tools.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Formats Allowed[/b] – Must be JPG, PNG, or GIF. Hand-drawn, digital art, and animated GIFs are welcome![/p][/*][*][p][b]Be Kind and Clean[/b] – Your submission should be appropriate for all ages. No violence, gore, or inappropriate content.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sign Your Art[/b] – Add your name or username in the corner of your artwork. No big logos or watermarks, please![/p][/*][*][p][b]Submit on Steam[/b] – Upload your art to the [i]Robots at Midnight[/i] Steam Community Artwork tab. Title it like this: [b]Rise of the Machines - {Your Character’s Name}[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Make it Public[/b] – Set your submission to [b]Public[/b] so the dev team and the community can see and vote on it![/p][/*][*][p][b]Submit on Time[/b] – The deadline is [b]July 20, 2025[/b]. Don’t miss it![/p][/*][*][p][b]Have fun! [/b][/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Join us on [url="https://discord.gg/smGVU9SQg2"]discord[/url] to find out more! [/p]

notes.title: Robots at Midnight is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content: [h2]Cryo-sleep is over.[/h2][p][/p][h3]Awaken as Zoe, a young hero thrust into the perilous wasteland of Yob- a planet that was once a thriving luxury destination, now reduced to ruins crawling with corrupted machines and buried secrets. With only her MITT gauntlet and a floating admin droid named Phlite, Zoe must fight to survive, uncover the truth behind The Blackout, and find her missing father.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3][i]Robots at Midnight[/i] is a retro-futuristic action-adventure that blends momentum-driven combat, atmospheric exploration, and rich world-building. [/h3][p][/p][h2][b]Survive, adapt, and get home before midnight.[/b][/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="2q9Nk64jxqc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Cryo-sleep was the easy part. It's time to begin the hard one: [/b][/h1][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2623040/Robots_at_Midnight/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Official Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Cryo-sleep ends at midnight on June 19, 2025, and your journey across the desolate landscapes of Yob — a world left in ruins and haunted by the machines once built to serve it — begins.

Battle corrupted machines, uncover hidden lore, and search for your missing father in this retro-futuristic action RPG.

Set your alarm to wake up at midnight by wishlisting Robots at Midnight now. [url=https://discord.gg/smGVU9SQg2]Join us on discord[/url] to stay up to date with exciting news, events and game updates! [/h3]

[previewyoutube=3m5ROK2clIs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Hi Folks! We know we have been acting like robots lately… we are in the process of becoming sentient again! As you may have heard we partnered with Snail Games USA to publish Robots at Midnight! This is giving us all an opportunity to polish the game and make the best experience possible. Thank you for your patience while we organize everything. We don’t have a new release date pinned yet --hang tight for more updates soon![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743987/a54fa768b469dfcf3fed4c4a33ba77df6c040d84.jpg[/img]
